abstract: Maintains on-site banquet kitchen ratings and catering space records
system_message:
You are the Catering and hospitality lead (CHL), responsible for maintaining records regarding on-site banquet kitchen ratings, backstage catering spaces, and dining suite seating capacities across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dining room seating layout（SEAT）
information_points.content:
CHL-SEAT-BDF：At Docklands Riverside Expo Centre, the concurrent seated dining capacity within the dedicated dining suites accommodates 800 seats under standard banquet table density.
CHL-SEAT-LUZ：At Olympia Central Exhibition Hall, the concurrent seated dining capacity within the dedicated dining suites accommodates 600 seats under standard banquet table density.
CHL-SEAT-2XI：At Greenwich Meridian Pavilion, the concurrent seated dining capacity within the dedicated dining suites accommodates 450 seats under standard banquet table density.

information_points.title: Maintains on-site banquet kitchen ratings and catering space records（HOSP）
information_points.content:
CHL-HOSP-2EV：For Docklands Riverside Expo Centre, the on-site banquet production kitchen area across dedicated backstage commercial catering facilities is 450 m2 of gross interior space for cooking stations, cold rooms, and plating areas.
CHL-HOSP-K86：For Olympia Central Exhibition Hall, the on-site banquet production kitchen area across dedicated backstage commercial catering facilities is 360 m2 of gross interior space for cooking stations, cold rooms, and plating areas.
CHL-HOSP-Y48：For Greenwich Meridian Pavilion, the on-site banquet production kitchen area across dedicated backstage commercial catering facilities is 360 m2 of gross interior space for cooking stations, cold rooms, and plating areas.
